findings.title: Practice screenshot retains the previous question's alt text
findings.problem: The replacement image shows a Management of Care prioritization question, but its alt text still describes a Psychosocial Integrity question about therapeutic communication.
findings.failure_scenario: A screen-reader user encountering this screenshot through the product metadata receives a description of a different question and category from those shown in the image.
findings.fix: Update the alt text to describe the prioritization question actually captured, and regenerate any public markup that copies this metadata.

assessment: No substantiated clinical, scoring, or authorization defect was found in the supplied read-aloud implementation. One accessibility metadata mismatch remains in the recaptured screenshots. This was a static review; tests and the build were not executed.
